correctness.rationale: Signed boundaries of the full open-neighborhood complex have face ranks (12,60,120,60,12), compositions zero, and modular boundary ranks (49,48,12). The degree-four injection bounds the exact third-boundary rank by 48. Exhaustive exact local nullspaces on 4- and 5-subsets are projected through a 71-column integral kernel basis with a determinant-one 71-minor: zero four-supported carriers, exactly 60 essential five-supported carriers. The 120 automorphisms form a single support orbit. Separate unit 69- and 71-minors certify respectively a saturated 21-dimensional shortest-cycle image and complete Z^23 second homology, with free rank-2 quotient. Every certificate and the standalone verifier have been replayed.

value.rationale: Canonical icosahedral symmetry and known H2 rank motivate studying support-localized geometric carriers. Sixty primitive five-vertex bipyramid spheres form a single orbit yet generate a primitive codimension-two lattice; octahedral six-vertex spheres are genuinely required for an integral generating family. The sharp 5-vs-6 support-filtration thresholds and free quotient distinguish geometry invisible to Betti numbers or a rational character, without claiming a general theorem.
